patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Constant Contact and Mailjet share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Constant Contact only if your buying job matches “SMB and local-business email marketing with event tools and brand recognition across North” rather than Mailjet's shape. Choose Mailjet only if your buying job matches “EU-friendly email platform for marketing and transactional sending with send-volume pricin” rather than Constant Contact's shape. Workflow advantage differs because Constant Contact is shaped for SMB and local-business email marketing with event tools and brand reco whereas Mailjet is shaped for EU-friendly email platform for marketing and transactional sending wit. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Constant Contact and Mailjet share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Constant Contact is SMB and local-business email marketing with event tools and brand recognition across North America.; Mailjet is EU-friendly email platform for marketing and transactional sending with send-volume pricing (Sinch)..
- Researched limits: Constant Contact — No forever-free plan — trial-only entry; Mailjet — Free plan daily send cap (200/day).

Limitations — Constant Contact: No forever-free plan — trial-only entry; Contact-tier pricing rises steeply as the list grows; Mailjet: Free plan daily send cap (200/day); Automation depth concentrates on Premium+.

Poor-fit cases: Constant Contact is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No forever-free plan — trial-only entry · Mailjet is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Free plan daily send cap (200/day) · Avoid Constant Contact if you actually need Mailjet's motion (EU-friendly email platform for marketing and transactional sending with send-vol)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
